sunoData.title: Frostbound Pass
sunoData.tags: Ambient game music with icy pads, distant felt piano, slow breathing drones, and sparse bell motifs in a spacious 72 BPM pulse; intro opens on wind-like synth and cracked ice textures, verse sections drift through frozen plains with low sub pulses and brushed percussion, mid-section climbs add trembling strings and rising harmonics, final section widens into lonely mountain ascent with shimmering high notes and descending bass. Soft stereo snow grain, reversed swells into transitions, subtle tape hiss, and a wide cinematic mix with cold, polished clarity., ambient
